analytic_scope.gate: No efficient quantum decoder, speedup, novelty, or classical hardness claim.
analytic_scope.time: O(p) field operations plus polynomial(log p) setup; exponential in bit input length log p.
analytic_scope.validity: Every monic quadratic over F_p for p>=5; irreducibility fixes the native sign-only promise.
analytic_scope.working_space: O(log p) bits for a constant number of field registers and loop counters, with streaming input; implementation/runtime overhead not measured. Source-table storage is harness-only.

analytic_field_operations_per_attack.scope: Logical field operations of written attack; conversions, field setup, iteration, and source/verification excluded. Division counts as one inversion and one multiplication.

p3_expected_failure: For each irreducible quadratic, same formula returns b and c+1 modulo 3; retained, not repaired.

source_model.attack_access: Only p and an iterator of chi(f(x)) at public x=0,...,p-1; no b,c, full field values, or extension-field queries.
source_model.input: Public growing odd prime p; hidden monic irreducible f=x^2+b*x+c over F_p.
source_model.oracle_source: Sage constructs private source polynomial and table outside attack; truth used only by harness.
source_model.output: Recovered coefficients b,c, followed by independent random-query verification.
